lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-density cluster of high-luminance circular blobs immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to a lower-frequency, grid-like arrangement of larger-diameter blobs along the mid-lateral flank toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows, forming a coarse geometric grid of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, circular, high-luminance pixel clusters localized within the visible macro-mask of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
